lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, with the highest-intensity nodes concentrated in the central region posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the visible mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a distinct internal spotting pattern, though the pixel intensity and contrast are lower than the primary lateral flank constellation.
